about: Groups of names of one function of the standard library: score.py counts every name of a group as its representative, for every tool and both graphs, outside the analysed package. A group is here only if its names are one object on every supported CPython (3.12 to 3.15; tests/test_same_function_table.py checks the interpreter that runs it). A person reviews each group and writes its source. Keep the groups sorted by representative and the names sorted.
